speaker: Penny
text: Pathetic. All of you, completely pathetic.

speaker: Sheldon
text: It only moves in time. It would be worse than useless in a swamp. My turn.

speaker: Sheldon
text: Leonard, it's two in the morning. So it's my turn. Why didn't you set it for the day before yesterday?

speaker: Leonard
text: So? Because I want to go back and keep myself from getting a time machine.

speaker: Sheldon
text: You can't. If you were to prevent yourself from buying it in the past, you would not have it available in the present to travel back and stop yourself from buying it. Ergo, you would still have it. This is a classic rookie time travel mistake.
